Rashi on Niddah 46a:10:1.hebrew: והוא שעודן בו - כשהגדיל, אבל נשרו בינתיים, איגלאי מילתא דשומא הוי:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:10:1.english: And this is when they are still on him - When he has grown up; but if they fell out in the meantime, it is revealed that it was a mole.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:12:1.english: Taught Rava's teaching in this wording - For you also learn from it [that] during the time is like before the time.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:12:2.hebrew: ממאנת והולכת - ואין חוששין שמא הביאה ב' שערות, דאפילו הביאה — שומא נינהו, והיינו תוך זמן כלפני זמן:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:12:2.english: Continues to perform refusal - And we are not concerned that perhaps she developed two hairs, for even if she developed [them], they are [merely] a mole; and this is [the principle that] "during the time is like before the time."

Rashi on Niddah 46a:13:1.hebrew: אינה ממאנת - שמא הביאה, ועכשיו הוי סימן, דהא לאחר זמן הוא. ואם יבמה היא, לא חשבינן לה גדולה לענין חליצה, ואינה חולצת:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:13:1.english: She may not perform refusal - Lest she developed [two hairs], and now it is a [valid] sign, for this is after the time. And if she is a yevama, we do not consider her an adult with regard to ḥalitza, and she does not perform ḥalitza.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:13:2.english: She is an adult - If she has developed [signs of puberty].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:14:1.hebrew: וכי תימא מספקא ליה - אם הביאה אם לא הביאה, הלכך: מיאון לא — דלמא הביאה, וחליצה נמי לא — שמא לא הביאה:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:14:1.english: And if you would say that he is uncertain - Whether she developed [signs of puberty] or she did not develop [them]; therefore, refusal is not [performed] — lest she developed [them], and ḥalitza is also not [performed] — perhaps she did not develop [them].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:14:2.hebrew: והא מיפשט פשיטא ליה לרבא - דכיון דהגיעה לכלל שנותיה, דודאי הביאה:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:14:2.english: And is it not obvious to Rava - That since she reached her full age, she certainly developed [signs of puberty]?

Rashi on Niddah 46a:17:1.hebrew: ה"מ לענין - דאי אתיא למיחלץ לאחר זמן, ובדקנו ולא אשכחן ליה, חיישינן למימר גדולה היא ותחלוץ, שהסימנין נשרו:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:17:1.english: This applies with regard to - For if she comes to perform ḥalitza after the time, and we examined [her] and did not find [signs] on her, we are concerned to say [that] she is an adult and should perform ḥalitza, as the signs fell out.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:17:2.hebrew: אבל לענין מיאון חיישינן - שמא נשרו לחומרא, וקנאה בביאה, ובעיא גט:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:17:2.english: But with regard to refusal, we are concerned - Perhaps they fell out, as a stringency; and he acquired her through intercourse, and she requires a bill of divorce.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:18:1.hebrew: והא חיישינן קאמר - ולא ודאי נשרו, וחיישינן לחומרא משמע:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:18:1.english: But he says "we are concerned" - And not that they definitely fell out, and "we are concerned" implies [only] as a stringency.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:19:1.hebrew: אלא לעולם - אינה ממאנת דרבא בדלא בדקנוה. הלכך, מסתמא אמרינן: כיון שהגיעה לכלל שנותיה, ודאי אית לה, ואינה צריכה בדיקה, ובעיא גט:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:19:1.english: Rather, actually - Rava's [statement,] "she may not perform refusal," [refers to a case] where we did not examine her. Therefore, by default we say: Since she has reached the full measure of her years, she certainly has [signs of puberty], and does not require examination, and requires a bill of divorce [rather than refusal].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:19:2.hebrew: ולענין חליצה חיישינן גרסינן - כלומר, ולענין חליצה משום הכי אינה חולצת, דחיישינן שמא לא הביאה סימנין. ודקשיא לך: האמר רבא חזקה הביאה סימנין? ל"ק: כי אמר רבא חזקה למיאון, דלא ממאנת מסתמא, אבל לחליצה בעיא בדיקה:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:19:2.english: "And with regard to ḥalitza we are concerned" is the reading - That is to say, with regard to ḥalitza, it is for this reason that she does not perform ḥalitza, because we are concerned that perhaps she did not develop signs [of puberty]. And [as for] that which was difficult for you: "Didn't Rava say [that there is a] presumption that she developed signs [of puberty]?" [This is] not difficult: When Rava said [there is a] presumption, [it was] with regard to refusal, that she does not perform refusal by default; but with regard to ḥalitza, she requires examination.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:20:1.hebrew: חוששין שמא נשרו - ואם הגיעה לכלל שנותיה, ובדקו ולא אשכחו, לא ממאנת:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:20:1.english: We are concerned that perhaps they fell out - And if she reached the full measure of her years, and they examined [her] and did not find [signs of maturity], she does not perform refusal [mi'un].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:21:1.english: Where he betrothed her during the time - [In the case of] an orphan [girl, betrothed] with the consent of her mother and brothers, [and] with her [own] consent.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:21:2.hebrew: ובעל אחר זמן דאיכא ספיקא - דאשת איש דאורייתא, דבשעת בעילה דלאחר זמן שמא הביאה, והויא לה ביאה זו קדושין גמורין, דהא גדלה, ושוב אינה יוצאה במיאון:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:21:2.english: And he engaged in intercourse after the time, where there is an uncertainty - [Whether she is] a married woman by Torah law, for at the time of the intercourse after the time, perhaps she had developed [signs of puberty], and this intercourse constitutes full betrothal, since she has grown up, and she can no longer leave through refusal.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:21:3.hebrew: אבל מעיקרא - דמכי עברה שתא דתרתי סרי ולא בעל, לא חיישינן שמא נשרו, דהא לא הוו בה קדושין גמורין, דאין מעשה קטנה כלום אא"כ קבל אביה קדושין. הלכך מספיקא לא מחמרינן עלה היכא דלא אשכחן. אבל הביאה ודאי סימנין, אע"ג דקדושי קמאי לא הוו קדושין אלא מדרבנן, לא תקנו רבנן מיאון בגדולה, דלמא אתיא למאן הנבעלת לאחר שגדלה, דההיא הויא אשת איש, דביאה שבא עליה משגדלה מקדשה לה:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:21:3.english: But at the outset - That once the twelfth year has passed and he did not engage in intercourse [after that], we are not concerned that perhaps [signs of puberty] fell out, for there was no full betrothal in her case, as the act of a minor is nothing unless her father received betrothal [on her behalf]. Therefore, out of doubt we do not rule stringently regarding her where we did not find [signs]. However, if she definitely developed signs [of puberty], even though the initial betrothal was a betrothal only by rabbinic law, the Sages did not institute refusal [mi'un] for an adult woman, lest a woman who engaged in intercourse after she reached adulthood come to perform refusal [mi'un], for that woman is a married woman, since the intercourse that he engaged in with her once she reached adulthood betroths her.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:22:1.hebrew: הקדיש - תוך הזמן, תינוק היודע להפליא:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:22:1.english: [If] he consecrated - During the [transition] period, [in the case of] a child who knows how to articulate [vows].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:22:2.english: And he ate - That which he consecrated.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:22:3.english: He is flogged - And even though in other matters he is not subject to punishment.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:23:1.hebrew: כי יפליא - מיניה מרבינן מופלא סמוך לאיש. מופלא — יודע לפרש לשם מי נדר. סמוך לאיש — שהוא סמוך לבא לכלל גדול, דהיינו שנה אחת קודם זמן שהוא ראוי להביא שערות, והיינו בתינוקת כל י"ב, ובתינוק כל י"ג:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:23:1.english: When [one] clearly utters - From it we derive [the inclusion of] a mufla samuch le'ish [a discerning youth close to adulthood]. “Mufla” [means] one who knows how to explain in Whose Name he vowed; “samuch le'ish” [means] that he is close to attaining the status of an adult, that is, one year before the time that he is fit to develop [pubic] hairs, and that is, in [the case of] a girl, throughout [her] twelfth [year], and in [the case of] a boy, throughout [his] thirteenth [year].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:23:2.hebrew: ולא יחל - אע"ג דבהאי קרא לא כתיב כי יפליא, מ"מ כיון דנפקא לן מיניה דיודע להפלות הוי נדרו נדר, קאי בבל יחל, דהא כתיב איש כי ידור נדר וגו', ומופלא סמוך לאיש בכלל איש, וסמיך ליה ולא יחל דברו:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:23:2.english: And he shall not profane - Even though in this verse it is not written: "When he clearly utters," nevertheless, since we derive from it that [if one] knows how to articulate, his vow is a valid vow, he is subject to [the prohibition of] "he shall not profane." For behold, it is written: "When a man vows a vow..." etc., and one who can articulate close to adulthood [a mufla samukh le'ish] is included under "man," and juxtaposed to it is: "He shall not profane his word."

Rashi on Niddah 46a:3:1.hebrew: וטעמא - דחשיבי להו שערות, דלאחר זמן הוא, דגמרו למלתיה בין בשערות בין בשנים. הא תוך הזמן, חשבינן להו שומא, דקטן הוא, ולא מצית לרבויי מאיש:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:3:1.english: And the reason - That the hairs are considered [valid] is that it is after the time, for his development has been completed, both in hairs and in years. But within the time, we consider them a mole, for he is a minor, and you cannot include [him] from [the word] "a man."

Rashi on Niddah 46a:4:1.hebrew: בן ט' שנים שהביא שערות שומא - ואפי' לר' יוסי ברבי יהודה, ומבן ט' ועד בן י"ב ויום אחד פלוגתא:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:4:1.english: A nine-year-old who developed hairs [they are considered] a mole - And [this is] even according to Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda; and from [the age of] nine until twelve years and one day, [there is] a dispute.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:4:2.hebrew: שומא - ורוא"ה בלע"ז, ודרכה ליגדל שער בה:
Rashi on Niddah 46a:4:2.english: A mole - Verrue [wart] in Old French, and it is its nature for hair to grow on it.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:5:1.hebrew: הא י"ג גופיה סימן - ואפי' לרבנן, והדר תני כו':
Rashi on Niddah 46a:5:1.english: This implies that the thirteenth [year] itself is a sign - And [this is] even according to the Rabbis; and then [the baraita] teaches, etc.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:6:1.hebrew: מאי לאו תנאי היא - ואליבא דרבנן, י"ג הוי תוך זמן לתינוק, כדקתני במתני':
Rashi on Niddah 46a:6:1.english: Is it not [a dispute between] tanna'im - And according to the Rabbis, the thirteenth [year] is "during the time" for a boy, as is taught in the mishna.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:7:1.english: And the first clause - Where you make [year] thirteen a sign [of puberty].

Rashi on Niddah 46a:7:2.english: It is Rabbi - Who said that in [the case of] a female child, [the age of] thirteen is after the time.

Rashi on Niddah 46a:7:3.english: And the latter clause - Which implies [that it is] a mole:

Rashi on Niddah 46a:7:4.english: Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar - Who says that the thirteenth [year] for a girl is during the time. In all of these resolutions, we establish that during the time is like before the time.

Tosafot on Niddah 46a:12:1.hebrew: קטנה כל י"ב שנה ממאנת - להך לישנא, אין להוכיח דתוך זמן כלפני זמן, דהא ממאנת היינו דבדקו ולא אשכחו, או כמו שמעמיד במסקנא דלא בדקו; אבל היכא דאיכא שערות, מצינו למימר דהוי כלאחר זמן ואינה ממאנת. ומ"מ נראה דהלכה דתוך זמן כלפני זמן, דמ"ד כלאחר זמן איתותב לעיל, ור"נ דאמר לעיל נמי כתנאי דחי ליה הש"ס, וגם בלישנא קמא פסיק רבא בהדיא דתוך זמן כלפני זמן:
Tosafot on Niddah 46a:12:1.english: A minor [girl], all twelve years, may perform refusal - According to this version, there is no proof that [signs developed] during the time are like before the time, for [the ruling that] she may perform refusal is where they examined [her] and did not find [hairs], or as [the Gemara] establishes in the conclusion, that they did not examine [her]; but where hairs are present, we could say that it is [treated] like after the time, and she may not perform refusal. And nevertheless, it appears that the halakha is that during the time is like before the time, for the one who said [that it is] "like after the time" was refuted above, and Rav Naḥman, who said above as well that [it is subject to a dispute between] Tannaim, the Gemara rejected his [explanation], and also in the first version, Rava explicitly ruled that during the time is like before the time.

Tosafot on Niddah 46a:19:1.hebrew: אבל לחליצה בעיא בדיקה - תימה, דרבא סבר הכא דאינה חולצת עד שתהא גדולה; ובפ' התקבל (גיטין דף סה.) אמר רבא: ג' מדות בקטן: הגיע לעונת נדרים – נדרו נדר, וכנגדו בקטנה – חולצת. משמע דקטנה בהגעת לעונת נדרים דידה חולצת, דהיינו בת י"א ויום אחד; ואפי' מיירי התם בהביאה, הא אמר הכא דתוך זמן כלפני זמן! ורשב"ם פירש: כנגדו בקטנה היינו בת י"ב שנה ויום אחד, דהוי עונת נדרים דקטן; ולא נהירא. ומפרש ר"ת, דהתם רבא אליבא דר' יוסי, דקאמר קטנה חולצת, וקמ"ל דדוקא כשהגיעה לעונת נדרים. וכן משמע בפרק מצות חליצה (יבמות דף קה:), דאמר: מדברי ר' יוסי נלמד קטנה חולצת בפעוטות, כבת שית וכבת שבע, דאז היא בת כוונה לחליצה; ורבא אמר: עד שתגיע לעונת נדרים – פירוש: לרבי יוסי; והילכתא: עד שתביא ב' שערות – וכל זה מדברי רבא. ועוד י"ל, דהתם בפ' התקבל (גיטין דף סה.) גרסינן רבה, דהא קאמר התם: ולמכור בנכסי אביו עד שיהא בן כ' שנה; ואילו רבא אית ליה בפרק מי שמת (ב"ב דף קנה.) דלמכור בנכסי אביו עד שיהא בן י"ח. וכן צריך להיות שם בספרים, ולא כספרים דגרסי התם איפכא, כדמוכח סוגיא דהתם:
Tosafot on Niddah 46a:19:1.english: But for chalitzah she requires examination - It is astonishing, for Rava holds here that she does not perform chalitzah until she becomes an adult; whereas in chapter HaTikkabel (Gittin 65a), Rava said: "Three standards [apply] to a minor: [if he] reached the age of vows, his vow is a [valid] vow, and corresponding to it regarding a minor girl, she performs chalitzah." This implies that a minor girl, upon reaching her [own] age of vows—which is [at] eleven years and one day old—performs chalitzah. And even if [one would say that the statement] there is dealing with [a girl who] developed [two pubic hairs], didn't [Rava] say here that [pubic hairs appearing] within the time are like [those appearing] before the time? And Rashbam explained: "Corresponding to it regarding a minor girl" means [when she is] twelve years and one day old, which is the age of vows for a minor boy; but this is not plausible. And Rabbeinu Tam explains that there [in Gittin], Rava [was speaking] according to Rabbi Yose, who says [that] a minor girl performs chalitzah, and [Rava] teaches us that [this applies] specifically when she reached the age of vows. And so it implies in chapter Mitzvat Chalitzah (Yevamot 105b), where it says: "From the words of Rabbi Yose we may learn [that] a minor girl performs chalitzah [even] as a young child (pe'otot), around six or seven years old, for then she is capable of intent for chalitzah." And Rava said: "Until she reaches the age of vows"—meaning, according to Rabbi Yose; "and the halakhah is: until she brings two hairs"—and all this is from the words of Rava. And furthermore, one can say that there in chapter HaTikkabel (Gittin 65a), the textual reading is "Rabbah" [and not Rava], for behold, it says there: "and to sell from his father's property, until he is twenty years old"; whereas Rava holds in chapter Mi Shemet (Bava Batra 155a) that to sell from his father's property [he may do so once] he is eighteen years old. And so it must be [the reading] there in the books, and not like the books that read the opposite there, as is proven by the sugya there.

Tosafot on Niddah 46a:4:1.hebrew: בן ט' שנים שהביא ב' שערות שומא - אי ל"ג ויום אחד, אתי שפיר, דאתיא אף כרבי יוסי. ואי גרסינן ויום אחד, מיירי באין עודן בו בשנת י"ג, דמודה רבי יוסי בנשרו:
Tosafot on Niddah 46a:4:1.english: A nine-year-old [boy] who developed two hairs, [it is] a mole - If we do not read "and one day", it works out well, for it accords even with Rabbi Yosei. And if we read "and one day", it is dealing with [a case where] they are no longer upon him in the thirteenth year, for Rabbi Yosei concedes in [a case where] they fell out.
